title: Parametric and flexible outcome models under adversarial response surfaces
question: Do flexible outcome models remove the transport bias a parametric STC incurs under threshold, hinge and covariate-interaction surfaces, and with valid intervals, as overlap worsens?
design: Binary-outcome source trial with one adversarial surface feature at a time and targets at three distances; parametric STC, a GAM with smooth modification and a structured GAM with linear modification, standardized by G-computation. 12 cells, 500 replicates each.
